data.name: Hasyid
data.gender_notes: Hasyid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hasyid is an Arabic name derived from the root h-s-d, which means 'to sit' or 'to be present'. In the Islamic context, this name signifies a person who is constantly present and mindful of Allah, and is therefore considered modest, pious, and righteous. The name Hasyid carries the meaning “Modest and pious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasyid usually hope their child will grow to embody modest and pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be in the presence of Allah
data.etymology: Hasyid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Modest and pious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasyid total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.long_meaning: حسيد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الحسن الخُلُق والعفن والطبع. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47: ﴿وَلَقَد أَخَذنَاْ مِيثَاقَ اٱلَّذينَ أُوتُوااْ اَلْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلِكُم مِّن كتابٍ وَأَنتُم أَشَدُّ مِيثَاقًا وَأَشدُّ أَيمَانًا وَأَخذوا عَهْدَ اَلَّذينَ أَطَاعوا وَكَفَوا وَأَخذَ اَلرَّسولُ مِنكُم مَّيثَاقًا غَلِيظًاﴻ. و الحَسيد هو الشخص الذي يتصف بالحسن و الجود و الكرم.

in_urdu.name: حسید
in_urdu.meaning: حسید مطلب اچھے اخلاق والا، سچا، نیک
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسید ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب اچھے اخلاق والا، سچا، نیک ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔ اس نام کی اصلیت عربی زبان میں ہے جہاں سے یہ لفظ 'حسن' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب اچھائی یا خوبصورتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसिद
in_hindi.meaning: हसिद मतलब अच्छे اخلاق वाला, सच्चा, नेक

in_english.name: Hasyid
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hasyid originates from Arabic roots (حسن), meaning good-natured, honest, and kind-hearted. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person with excellent character and morals. The term 'حسن' (hasan) appears in the Quran, emphasizing good deeds and beautiful character. Historically, Hasyid has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing virtues of compassion and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hasyid carries a rich cultural heritage in the Muslim world. Historically, Hasyid is the name of a prominent Sufi (Islamic mysticism) order, known as the Hasyiyyah Order, which was founded by Sheikh Muhammad Al-Sanusi in the 18th century in what is now Libya. The order is known for its strict adherence to Sufi practices and its emphasis on education, social welfare, and the promotion of peace and unity. The name Hasyid has become synonymous with this spiritual tradition and the values it represents, such as piety, humility, and simplicity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hasyid signifies a deep connection to Allah and a commitment to living a pious and righteous life. The root meaning 'to sit' suggests a sense of stillness and focus, as if one is constantly in the presence of Allah. The name also carries the implication of mindfulness, as the person bearing this name is reminded to be ever-present and conscious of Allah's watchfulness. In Sufi philosophy, this level of consciousness is believed to lead to a deeper understanding of the divine and a greater closeness to Allah.
